scope: Current local mathematical sources, explicit review scopes, executed finite checks, compilation and visual inspection. Remote saving is verified separately after this file is committed.
reference_review: poisson-p4 main was rechecked at the recorded commit this turn; nc-cubic and asz4 commits are retained reference points.

mathematical_review.moduli_foundations: Root proof and independent review of the fpqc stacks, finite-window quotient presentations, regular normal cubic incidence, strict 2-fibres, tangent space and commutative fibre over nonreduced bases. No finite-type claim for the full inverse limit.
mathematical_review.categorical_comparison: Independent review of strong arrows, compatible 2-arrows, vertex scalar crossed module, pointed rigidification and relative line-bundle descent. Saturation, relative Hom base change and categorical reconstruction remain explicit hypotheses.
mathematical_review.period_forgetting: Review of the period groupoid, finite-type two-factor stabilizer reduction, twisted conjugacy and finite additional Zhang identifications. The new integer certificate establishes finite generic two-factor stabilizer, not its order.
mathematical_review.indexed_normal_rigidity: Root and independent review of the full indexed normal incidence over graded Artin ambient deformations, including a possibly nonflat relative stabilizer. Centralization and the strict four-dimensional formal fibre follow. No periodization of arbitrary Z ambient families is inferred.
mathematical_review.relative_nakayama: Proof reviewed conditional on the stated relative finite-free Koszul-dual Frobenius structure and the relative Nakayama comparison. Their automatic existence is not claimed.
mathematical_review.formal_ambient_comparison: Root and independent checks of the finite Beilinson window, projective frame slice, minimal hull comparison and the actual Qmod natural transformation at the commutative P4 point. This is a set-valued isomorphism-class Artin comparison; no higher-groupoid equivalence is asserted.
mathematical_review.formal_component_image: Independent review of the 37-dimensional formal component and the codimension-zero formal image after completion along the whole commutative ambient fibre. Flat completion, proper base change and formal functions apply. This is not a claim at one fixed cubic or on the smooth-proper subfunctor.
mathematical_review.cubic_artin_map: The actual envelope morphism and its tangent formula are identified. The 17-dimensional cubic Artin model uses the manuscript's homogeneous formality input. Compatibility of independently chosen formality coordinates in all orders is unproved.
mathematical_review.inherited_results: Existing numerical certificates were rerun. Valid existing proofs are retained, but all older PBW, mixed-centre, reconstruction and finite-order Bertini arguments did not receive a new exhaustive independent audit.
mathematical_review.novelty: Literature inputs and supplied proofs are separated. Priority and exhaustive novelty verification remain incomplete.
